## Weight Loss Counseling in San Antonio

Weight loss counseling is behavioral therapy that helps people understand and modify their relationship with food to address overeating, emotional eating, and obesity. It involves working with licensed therapists and counselors who specialize in the psychological factors that affect eating behaviors and weight. At the Bariatric Counseling Center in San Antonio, we provide weight loss counseling through an Intensive Outpatient Program that includes group and individual therapy, dietary guidance from registered dietitians, cooking classes with a professional chef, and mindful movement education. The program runs about three months, meeting two to three times per week, and is available onsite at our San Antonio facility or virtually throughout Texas. We are in network with most health insurance plans, and claims are processed under mental health benefits.
